name: Handel-C
summary: C-based hardware description language with CSP-style par blocks and channels, where each assignment takes one clock cycle; developed at Oxford and commercialised by Celoxica (DK Design Suite), later Agility and Mentor Graphics.

level_notes.1: The Celoxica Handel-C Language Reference Manual is the definition; a third-party hosted copy is linked.
level_notes.0: No open-source implementation; the DK compiler was proprietary.
level_notes.2: No modern secondary literature beyond the archived manual and encyclopedia entries.
